data.name: Pai Gow Poker by Pokerist
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to an amazing poker version of the familiar Pai Gow game! Place combination bets, beat the dealer with 7 cards in your hand, and win up to x20,000!

Game features

FREE CHIPS — Play the game every day to get free chips!

POKER AGAINST THE CASINO — Get 7 cards and split them into two hands, one hand of 5 cards and one hand of 2 cards. To win Pai Gow Poker, both of your hands have to be better than the dealer's!

HONE YOUR STRATEGY — Feel the thrill of Pai Gow in the familiar classic casino atmosphere! Your 5-card hand needs to be better than your 2-card hand. Everything else is up to you. Refine your skills in Pai Gow and win!

PLACE SIDE BETS — Want to win even more chips? Side bets help you win regardless of who wins the hand! Any combination from three of a kind and better makes you a Pai Gow Poker winner!

INSURANCE BET — In Pai Gow Poker, you can win with any cards in your hands! Even if your cards can't make a combination, you can still get a payout from an Insurance bet!

PLAY WITH A JOKER — Every Pai Gow Poker deck in our casino has a joker! The joker allows you to collect a straight or flush, replacing a missing card. If there are no combinations, the joker replaces an ace to make your chances of winning at the Pai Gow table even higher!

PVE CASINO GAMES — Play other casino games, all in one app: three card poker, blackjack, Ultimate Hold'em, roulette, baccarat, video poker, craps, and Keno!

VIP LEVELS — Get huge bonuses and exclusive access to the latest in-game features!

FAIR PLAY GUARANTEED — All our games use a Random Number Generator (RNG) and are certified by independent experts. We guarantee the best and fairest Pai Gow Poker experience!

CHAT WITH OTHER PLAYERS — Have even more fun at the casino tables with our convenient in-game chat, instant messenger, and animated emojis. Discuss the hands played or share your emotions with your Pai Gow Poker opponents and friends!

BUILD YOUR PROFILE — Share your successes with friends. Show off how many games you've played, your biggest wins, level, card collections, achievements, property and trophies!

UNIQUE AVATAR — Create a one-of-a-kind look in the avatar editor.

QUESTS — Complete daily quests to get free chips!

EASY TO LEARN — New to Pai Gow but always wanted to try it? Our simple-to-follow tutorial mode will help you take the first steps in Pai Gow Poker!

NO REGISTRATION — Choose guest mode to play poker against the house immediately after installing the game!

This game is only available to users of legal age. The game offers no possibility of winning money or anything of value. Success in playing this game does not imply your success in a similar real-money casino game.

Notice for players in Washington State

Due to legal restrictions in Washington State, this game is not available for players located in this region. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
